headlines.title: 央行今日开展10000亿元买断式逆回购操作 专家：体现了稳健偏松的货币政策取向
headlines.summary: 为保持银行体系流动性充裕，8月14日，中国人民银行将以固定数量、利率招标、多重价位中标方式开展10000亿元买断式逆回购操作。与此对应，8月14日有10000亿元6个月期买断式逆回购到期。因而本次操作实现对冲，届时买断式逆回购余额维持6.3万亿元。东方金诚首席宏观分析师王青分析称，考虑到8月4日以来货币市场隔夜利率（DR001）持续运行在政策利率下方，这或是8月份6个月期买断式逆回购未延续加量的一个原因。将二者联系起来看，中信证券首席经济学家明明团队分析认为，本次6M（6个月期）买断式逆回购到期量较大，等额续作搭配后续隔夜逆回购呵护流动性，体现了稳健偏松

headlines.title_en: PBOC conducts 1 trillion yuan outright reverse repo operation today; experts say it reflects a moderately loose monetary policy stance.
headlines.summary_en: To keep banking system liquidity ample, on Aug 14, the PBOC will conduct a 1 trillion yuan outright reverse repo operation via fixed quantity, interest rate bidding, and multiple-price pricing. Correspondingly, 1 trillion yuan of 6-month outright reverse repos mature on Aug 14, so this operation fully hedges, keeping the outright reverse repo balance at 6.3 trillion yuan. Dongfang Jincheng chief macro analyst Wang Qing said, given that the overnight money market rate (DR001) has been running below the policy rate since Aug 4, this may be one reason the August 6-month outright reverse repo was not expanded. Linking the two, CITIC Securities chief economist Ming Ming's team said the large maturity of this 6M outright reverse repo, paired with equal rollover and subsequent overnight reverse repos to safeguard liquidity, reflects a steady and moderately loose stance.

headlines.title_en: PBOC Deputy Governor Zou Lan attends BRICS Finance Ministers and Central Bank Governors Meeting.
headlines.summary_en: On Aug 12-13, 2026, PBOC Deputy Governor Zou Lan attended the first BRICS Finance Ministers and Central Bank Governors meeting of the year in Jaipur, India. Participants discussed global economic development and governance, improving the contingent reserve arrangement, and strengthening cooperation among BRICS countries in cross-border payments, sustainable finance, information security, and fintech.

headlines.title: China’s factory-gate prices growth slows to 3.5% in July amid lower fuel prices
headlines.summary:
China’s factory-gate prices growth slowed in July, as lower domestic fuel prices eased cost pressures triggered by the US-Israel war on Iran, while high temperatures dragged manufacturing.
The producer price index (PPI) rose by 3.5 per cent year on year last month, compared with 4.1 per cent in June, according to data released by the National Bureau of Statistics (NBS) on Sunday.

headlines.title: 多家小贷公司明示个贷综合融资成本上限，部分已低于12%
headlines.summary: 8月1日，《个人贷款业务明示综合融资成本规定》正式施行，要求贷款人向借款人展示综合融资成本明示表。记者注意到，多家小贷公司已经披露个人贷款业务综合融资成本上限，其中不少机构将上限设定在24%，也有部分公司将上限控制在12%以内。（上证报）

headlines.title_en: Several small-loan companies have disclosed upper limits on total consumer loan financing costs, with some already below 12%
headlines.summary_en: On Aug 1, the Regulations on Disclosing Comprehensive Financing Costs for Personal Loan Business took effect, requiring lenders to show borrowers a comprehensive financing cost disclosure table. Reporters noted that several small-loan firms have disclosed their upper limits for comprehensive financing costs on personal loan business, with many setting the cap at 24%, while some control it within 12%. (Shanghai Securities News)

headlines.title_en: Midday market close on August 14: ChiNext Index pared gains to rise 0.65%, with CPO concept stocks collectively strengthening
headlines.summary_en: 1. The Shanghai Composite oscillated in morning trade, while the ChiNext Index pulled back after an initial surge. CPO concept stocks strengthened, with Sinomach Precision, Allied, and Gongjin Electronics hitting limit-up. Optical fiber concepts rose intraday, with Hangzhou Cable hitting limit-up. Rare earth permanent magnet stocks climbed, with Jintian Copper hitting limit-up. On the downside, computing power leasing concepts corrected, with Chengdi Xiangjiang hitting limit-down; the power sector fell, with Meiyan Jixiang down over 8%. Decliners outnumbered advancers, with over 3,600 stocks lower across Shanghai, Shenzhen, and Beijing, and half-day turnover at 1.4 trillion yuan. At midday close, the Shanghai Composite fell 0.21%, the Shenzhen Component rose 0.08%, and the ChiNext rose 0.65%. 2. By sector concept, CPO, optical fiber, high-speed copper cable connections, and rare earth permanent magnets led gains; film & TV, power, dairy, and short drama concepts led losses. 3. Across both markets, 1,891 stocks rose with 40 at limit-up; 3,152 stocks fell with 5 at limit-down; 21 stocks broke their limit-up.

headlines.title: 崔东树：7月车市走弱是多重因素共振所致
headlines.summary: 8月14日，乘联分会秘书长崔东树发文指出，2026年7月车市走弱，是油价反弹、宏观走弱、季节性淡季、前期需求透支及政策切换等多重因素共振所致。地缘冲突引发霍尔木兹海峡通航扰动，推动国际油价震荡上行，2026年国内汽油价格累计上调1575元/吨，大幅抬高用车成本，燃油乘用车消费需求剧烈萎缩，但对商用车的影响很小。同时7月CPI、PPI环比回落、PMI景气下行，居民收入与消费预期偏谨慎，大额耐用品消费意愿低迷，住行消费持续走弱，拖累车市终端需求。叠加7月高温淡季压制线下到店客流、6月半年冲量提前透支市场需求，终端订单与客流同步回落。

headlines.title_en: Cui Dongshu: July auto market weakness driven by multiple factors.
headlines.summary_en: On Aug 14, CPCA Secretary-General Cui Dongshu noted that the weak auto market in July 2026 resulted from multiple factors including oil price rebound, weaker macro conditions, seasonal off-season, earlier demand exhaustion, and policy shifts. Geopolitical conflicts disrupted Hormuz Strait navigation, pushing international oil prices higher; domestic gasoline prices rose a cumulative 1,575 yuan/ton in 2026, significantly raising vehicle costs and sharply shrinking fuel passenger car demand, though with little impact on commercial vehicles. Meanwhile, July CPI and PPI fell month-on-month, PMI sentiment weakened, household income and consumption expectations turned cautious, big-ticket durable goods spending was weak, and housing and travel consumption continued to soften, dragging terminal auto demand. Combined with July's hot-weather off-season suppressing offline showroom traffic and June's half-year sales push prematurely exhausting demand, terminal orders and foot traffic fell together.
